notes.title: 0.5 Beta Out now!
notes.content:
Things added:

- Added a light system
- Added more guns
- Added a vignette
- Added bobbing to the player, items, and enemies
- Added an outline to every sprite without an outline

- Changed menu and Hotbar sprites
- Changed the font
- Changed the tileset

Sadly, I had to remove the text system but it will come back.
